title: Force Formula Due to the Pressure Difference
text: The force $$F$$ due to the pressure difference is given by $$F=\Delta{}p\, A.$$ Apply Bernoulli's equation to find the pressure difference first, then multiply by the area to get the force on the roof.

title: Bernoulli’s Equation
text: $$\Delta{}p=\tfrac12\rho{}v**2,$$ where $$\Delta{}p$$ is the pressure difference, $$\rho$$ is the density of air, and $$v$$ is the speed of the wind.
